summary: Implemented the Tabs feature (not run, per instructions; verified by reading only). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs (__all__ = ["Tab", "Tabs"]); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges blended color via style + blended to keep meta; layout resolver unchanged because its Edge protocol already has size, min_size=1, fraction=1. Added docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css, new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Deviations to review: bar position uses the displayed-tab index (equals find_tab_by_name when names are unique) to satisfy acceptance criterion 11 with duplicate names; letter search applies only to single-character keys; a Tab name of None falls back to the label, while an empty string is kept. Nothing committed; test suite not executed.
